sections.heading: What is Identity Theft?
sections.text: Identity theft is the misuse of your personal or financial information.

sections.heading: Common Types of Fraud
sections.text:
- Phishing
- Online scams
- Banking fraud
- SIM swap fraud

sections.heading: Warning Signs
sections.text: Unknown transactions, unexpected OTPs, and suspicious messages.

sections.heading: Protection Tips
sections.text:
- Never share OTP or PIN
- Use secure websites
- Keep data private

sections.heading: Strong Passwords
sections.text: Use complex passwords and enable two-factor authentication.

sections.heading: Monitoring
sections.text: Check bank statements regularly and enable alerts.

sections.heading: If Fraud Happens
sections.text: Inform bank immediately, change passwords, and report the issue.
